text: We had a great experience here!  My Husband and I both had cleaning and polishing done.  I am very nervous about dentist, but this dentist was very gentle and patient. The office is clean, bright and attractive and everyone is so friendly.  I would highly recommend coming here for your dental work when you’re in Phuket.

This was my best dental experience ever. I needed to have a tooth removed, and just when I thought it was only beginning, everything was already done 😁
I felt no pain at all. Everything was so gentle and careful that I had no swelling or pain afterward, and I didn’t even need to take painkillers.
I’d also like to highlight the very friendly and welcoming atmosphere.
I highly recommend this dental clinic 👍🏻

I don’t know from where they got review. I think I should give my experience for people who is going to visit them. I got tooth pain and all dentist around of me was fully booked and they had free time (I think at that time it was red flag). My roots were infected and I had only one week left in Phuket. I give 2 star only cause he helped for a while
The place is not clean. The doctor is very rude, I was screaming cause of pain and he said if I hear something from you, you go out (excuse me, where should I go with open thooth?) before coming I checked the prices on the website and I was short on money at that time. By the end they charged me 4000 batt for just cleaning infection and put medicine without permanent filling. Even in dubai they don’t have such high prices, I understand if his job and his whole clinic worth it, but he is def overcharging. If you have choice to go to other place, check out different dentist. I went to the dentist in another country he had to do everything from the beginning, cause he put wrong medication

Would not recommend due to dishonest pricing structures. Their website lists lower rates, but they have quietly raised their actual prices without updating their online menu. This is unprofessional and a complete waste of time for patients trying to plan emergency treatments.

Highly misleading pricing. I looked at their official website to check the rates for a cleaning and diagnostic work, only to find out they have significantly raised their prices in-office but haven't updated their site. It is incredibly frustrating to deal with a bait-and-switch on costs when you are already dealing with acute tooth pain and planning travel across the island. This is entirely unprofessional digital practice. Be careful and confirm rates over the phone before wasting your time driving here.

Lovely doctor who was very informative about what's going on with my teeth, unfortunately he was unable to preform the surgery on my wisdom tooth due to an infection and impaction. X-ray was quick and easy. The reception staff was super friendly and managed to book me in with a maxillofacial surgeon the same day. Everything was smooth and easy. Thank you so much.

The best dentist I have been too!
I was recommended here by a friend after I visited a dentist in Patong and was told I needed 8 fillings....!
Dr Theplaong advised no fillings were needed, I really dodged a bullet there.
On my second visit I had teeth cleaning and whitening, the cleaning was least uncomfortable I have had and Dr Theplaong was there throughout the whole whitening process. Very pleased with the results.
The staff are all so friendly and welcoming it was a pleasure to visit again.
If dental work is extortionate in your home country, I would highly recommend visiting Phuket dental center, right next door to Phuket hospital. 🙂

I had an excellent experience here. I had to have 3 teeth extracted and honestly didn't feel a thing. The doctor is very professional and really gives you his time, and the staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. 5 stars! ⭐️

This being my second visit to Phuket dental center clinic, I am once again impressed by the exceptional service they provide. The staff is consistently friendly and attentive, ensuring a comfortable experience. Dr Prasert expertise is unmatched, delivering outstanding care. I continue to highly recommend this clinic for their consistent excellence in dental services.

Dr. Prasert is a highly  skilled dentist with a knack for detail. Attentive and very friendly staff at reception and working with the dentist. Great service and high quality crowns!!. This dental clinic  I can definitely recommend without any doubt. So glad I found them .

I came to this office last minute with pain in my wisdom tooth, they look X-rays and we made an appointment for surgery the next day. It went so well! The doctor is very kind & knowledgeable. I had minor pain & swelling!! It healed within 1 week. I definitely recommend this office!! And great prices. Thank you
Fantastic doctor. Very professional. My son had to fix his brackets and he was exceptionally fantastic. Thank you again for the fast help.

Firstly I got a same day appointment & I was late, the staff were lovely & polite!

I had a clean & polish within 30mins tops, when they gave me back the mirror I was shocked at how amazing it was!

I have been getting cleans in my home country (New Zealand) & they were no where near as good!

Good service! Great job! I will going back to get my wisdom teeth out - very reasonable price!

Awesome and professional doctor! I was given an emergency appointment last minute as I was in pain (and traveling so only in Phuket for one day) and had to get one of my wisdom teeth removed. The doctor was so kind and nice, making me feel at home and comfortable and the whole procedure was done in under 30 minutes. I would definitely recommend this dentist!

Visited them on 12/28 for a clean up and the doctor was absolutely amazing. He was extremely professional and explained all the concerns I was facing. He told me about the three different types of teeth alignment and I found out I had an underbite. I would highly recommend coming here. The receptionist was also super nice and understanding when we arrived late. Thank you Phuket Dental Center, we will be back again! :)

Had a filling fall out and was able to make an appointment the same day I reached out (via Messenger)… I came out smiling again after he did his magic; great communication throughout the procedure and feels like my tooth is back to original! Would definitely recommend anybody to go here for any dental work!!

I've been seeing this great Dentist for about 15 years.  When no other dentist would try a bonding to fix a couple teeth, he did it for me.  Most thought it would only last a couple weeks but it lasted 12 years. Great guy!

As someone who lived in Phuket, this is the best dental clinic around. I’ve been to many dentists around the world and felt very well taken care here. Perfect for your typical cleaning but also, when I chipped a tooth, the fixing was impeccable. Dr. Praset speaks great English and is very professional.

I want to say thank you!  I had a tooth removed today that only had roots left.  I am very afraid of dentists and I understand that I am a nervous patient.  The doctor was very careful and calmed me, and the lovely nurses held my hand so that I would not be nervous!  5 hours after removal, I feel great.  I love this clinic and would recommend it to everyone!  Once again, many thanks to the whole team)

I never really post reviews but feel so very happy with the kindness care and service I received from this fantastic dentist. The whole staff were super friendly and very accommodating. Most importantly though the expertise of this dentist means that the crown he has placed on front tooth will only be noticed by me as the match is so perfect. I highly recommend this place over anywhere else I have been in Phuket.

Dr Prasert is the most friendly and accomplished dentists in Phuket. His manner with children is exceptional, putting them instantly at ease. My daughter got her braces on with him one year ago, and they are almost finished already. He said she’s one of the fastest patients he’s ever had. She loves going in to see him and they have become great friends as you can see. We can’t recommend this dental clinic enough 😁

I am an expat living in Phuket and I have been a patient of Dr. Prasert for about 5 yrs now! He is a great dentist that takes pride in his work. I have already recommended him and will continue to do so! His staff is very friendly and …

I love this dentist. I've had 2 wisdom teeth (1 impacted, 1 simple extraction) removed here and both recoveries were great. I was a nervous wreck not being home for something like this, but I felt great. The dentist is kind, gentle, and talked me through every step. I felt no pain during the extraction, and healed quickly.

I had a great experience at this clinic! The lingual retainer behind my lower front teeth had broken and I had no idea where to go. I googled places nearby and decided to try this clinic out. It was a great decision because they took such good care of me. The doctor is an excellent professional with great care for his patients. He was so kind and even gave me a very generous discount of 1000B which was so welcome as I am low on money and still awaiting my first salary. Thanks to his work and advise, my teeth are okay :) He even gave me a special floss wire to clean between my retainer (for free!) I reccommend this place to everybody!

Phuket Dental Center has an amazing, caring, knowledgeable, kind, loving, and experienced team! Very impressive! Kum setup an appointment for me very fast! She is a delight and will make you feel at home :) Dr. Prasert is so kind and a true professional! He fixed the few fillings needed and made me feel totally comfortable. He gave me some great knowledge and advice about how to keep my fillings clean and maintain them for long health. The office is extremely clean and welcoming. Very Covid safe! The location is perfect and easy to find. Best dental experience I have ever had!!! Thank You to the whole Team, a pleasure 🙏❤️😁

Amazing dentist and kind human !! Saved my vacations - I got a bad infection and toothache due to my wisdom tooth and going back home only in 2 weeks. I was very scared about what to as its first time I have an emergency like this. Luckily came to this clinic where staff is incredibly nice and helpful and speak great English. Managed to look at my situation after a very short wait and arranged for an emergency visit for me in an hour. Doctor was very gentle and understanding. If I lived here, I would be coming only here for my dental care :)

Thank you very much Doctor for fixing the front tooth crown. Now I can confidently smile without worrying about the discolored gum and the uneven color of the crown. ❤️also thanks to the friendly staffs for assisting me with the taxi and holding my hand for being scared.
I had teeth cleaning and polishing here, everything was great 🙏 …

Dr Prasert Theplaong was recommended to us by long time expat friends and we've been patients of his for several years.  We have a clean and check up once or twice a year, sometimes needing an occasional filling.  Dental work done has been thorough and painless and we've never had unnecessary work recommended.  Two years ago my husband had false teeth made and they have been perfect in every way.  Today I had the most quick, efficient and painless tooth extraction ever!  Dr Theplaong is a skilled dental technician.  We confidently recommend him to anyone looking for a competent dentist in Phuket.

We have been visiting Dr Aud for the past 3 years and have always felt so satisfied with his care. He is a skilled dentist and takes the time to share his knowledge and explain any procedures. As a parent I have been so pleased with his attention to my children’s’ teeth and the warm way he talks with them to put them at ease. My daughter has just finished having braces from Dr Aud and from start to finish we were impressed with the service and my daughter now has lovely straight teeth as well as a respect and understanding of the dental profession. I also must mention Dr Aud’s secretary who always greets us so warmly and takes care of the administration so efficiently.
Thank you and we will continue to come to your practice as long as we live in Phuket - perhaps even longer!!

Very happy to chose this doctor. He gave honest opinion and not only interested in selling a product like so many other clinics in Phuket. The result is amazing … very happy to choose this clinic. Kind Regards, Eric & NamHom

We had to get appointment on very short notice because of pain. The staff was super friendly and professional and we got appointment same day. The doctor was very professional and also very friendly. Professional equipment. Very good communication, very fair pricing. Luckily we didn't need further treatment and the doctor didn't try to upsell unnecessary treatment. Very trustworthy!
Kob khun kab.

I can only talk about my personal experience. This is what happened from the beginning to the end. Dr. Prasert Theplaong was recommended to me. I was in Singapore at the time. I sent him an email explaining my dental situation. I expressed …
Highly recommended.  Best dentist in Phuket Just did a crown for me.  Always in a good mood, with excellent English and a lovely staff and family.

I asked for advice about a problem I was experiencing. I was given expert and objective advice. Very much appreciated. The reception was also very friendly and relaxing. Good English spoken. Highly recommended.

Exceptionally friendly and professional service. I got an appointment for the next day, we could communicate in English and I could pay by card. Dr P even did an extra tooth cleaning for me. 100% recommended.
Dr P and his staff are the best. Had a emergency wisdom tooth extraction done in under 22 minutes. My favorite DDS ever,

Incredible place! Very kind and professional people, I'm so glad that I came to them! I wish them a long and happy life 😌

Teeth cleaning and fillers are awesome 💯

Great dentist!
Come because of an swallow cheek, diagnosed and treated perfectly!
I can recommend!
Best dentist ever! Very friendly, good prices for all simple and comlicate work. We join him since 10 years
One of the best dentist I have ever been to! He speaks great English and will not break the bank!
Excellent service, friendly staff.  Had crowns and veneers done.  Extremely happy.
Very professional dental care. Best crowns i ever had!
Got cleaning here. Great job sir, thank you🦷✨ …

Excellent service with a friendly smile.
Highly recommended.
Excellent service, very professional, and very caring team :-)
Poor experience. Got a filling done only for it to fall off the very next day.

My father broke a front tooth with a crown while on vacation. At the clinic, they fitted a post with a build-up filling and a crown. Excellent work! I know what I'm talking about because I work at a dental practice myself. A huge compliment to the dentist! Highly recommended!

Dr. Prasert is highly skilled, meticulous in his work, and has extensive experience. He can explain every patient's problem clearly and is very sincere, holding nothing back. If you need dental work done, I highly recommend this clinic.

I want to thank the clinic and the doctor for their sensitive management and help with a serious infection.

My story:
It turned out I had a serious infection.
I came in with a swollen cheek, fever, and pain where I had a complex wisdom oak removed a month ago (not at this clinic).

The doctor saw me, took X-rays, and examined everything thoroughly.
He drained a lot of pus, prescribed treatment, and scheduled follow-up appointments to make sure everything was recovering.
After the first appointment, I felt significantly better; the swelling and pain went away.
I am very grateful to the doctor and recommend this clinic.
The prices are very reasonable, and the service and professionalism are excellent!

I urgently needed a broken tooth removed. I waited until the last minute in Russia, afraid to go, but after the plane, my jaw was swollen and infected. I was looking for somewhere to go and found this place based on reviews. The doctor was …

I've always been very afraid of dentists, and going to the dentist was always a difficult experience for me. Today, I can confidently say that my opinion has changed.
The doctor is a super-high-level professional. They removed my wisdom tooth in 10 minutes and sent me home happy. The staff, service, and doctor's qualifications are top-notch, 10 out of 10! I'll definitely come back and recommend him to my friends.
My favorite dentist! His many years of experience, honesty and kindness are the main advantages. When we come to Phuket, we only go to him. ☺️

Excellent doctor and his team!
They installed a crown on a problematic tooth. Quickly, calmly, and professionally.
I had no reason to worry or be nervous.
The price was also quite reasonable.
I just had my teeth done. The dentist is excellent; it didn't hurt at all. They were able to explain all my problems. The staff at the clinic were also very kind.
The doctor is very lovely and kind.
